topic: Poorest countries by GDP per capita

interpretations.label: Nominal GDP per capita
interpretations.description: Gross domestic product divided by midyear population, expressed in current US dollars without adjusting for differences in local price levels.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Nominal GDP (USD) / Total Population, measured in US Dollars
caveats: Strongly affected by currency exchange rate fluctuations
Does not reflect purchasing power or local cost of living

interpretations.label: GDP per capita, PPP (Recommended)
interpretations.description: Gross domestic product converted to international dollars using purchasing power parity rates, providing a better measure of relative economic wellbeing.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: PPP GDP / Total Population, measured in International Dollars
caveats: PPP benchmarks are periodically revised based on international price comparison programs
Data collection can be sparse or estimated for conflict-affected states

knownRisks: Lack of historical data prior to independence or state formation (e.g., South Sudan)
Significant data gaps during periods of civil war or severe political instability
Methodological revisions in national accounts by reporting governments
